title: frasera tetrapetala
intro: Frasera tetrapetala, commonly known as the Mountain Sneezeweed, is a perennial plant native to the western regions of North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Frasera tetrapetala include expectorant, antitussive, and antipyretic effects, helping to relieve coughs, sneezing, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, sesquiterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
